scope: 41 evidence/*/STATUS.md records; local historical statuses, no live upstream recheck

findings.title: addressable: route_from returns "" when only the base has a query
findings.note: Full panel + focused re-review: all SHIP (colon case and quadratic regex fixed).
findings.assessment: RFC 3986 resolution plus maintainer issue #126 supplies a concrete round-trip expectation. Strong candidate for tracing issue-derived intent; panel and focused re-review approved.

findings.title: addressable: {+v}/{#v} re-encode existing %XX
findings.note: Panel split 6-3 under the side-effect rule (literal %XX changes meaning; %2e%2e filter bypass). Andrew to decide: drop, or file as an issue.
findings.assessment: RFC 6570 grounding, but panel split over behavior changes. Preserve as an adjudication case, not an unqualified positive.

findings.title: adonisjs/http-server: cookie maxAge 0 drops Max-Age
findings.note: Ready for review.
findings.assessment: Zero is accepted by the API but a truthiness check drops Max-Age. Existing serializer/clearCookie behavior supports expected output.

findings.title: adonisjs/http-server: findOrFail throws a plain Error instead of E_CANNOT_LOOKUP_ROUTE
findings.note: Panel: file as an issue first; the fix misses urlBuilder.urlFor.
findings.assessment: Documented E_CANNOT_LOOKUP_ROUTE and issue history support the mismatch; proposed fix misses urlBuilder.urlFor.

findings.title: adonisjs/http-server: withQs on a URL that already has a query adds a second ?
findings.note: Panel: forwarded params can now duplicate a hard-coded key; needs a code revision and re-review.
findings.assessment: Existing-query redirect gets a second question mark; proposed merge can duplicate hard-coded keys. Revise and re-review.

findings.title: adonisjs/http-server: status(205).send(body) sends a body
findings.note: Panel: stream()/download() still send a body; scope and text must change.
findings.assessment: HTTP 205 no-content requirement is an explicit standard; fix coverage still omits stream/download.

findings.title: adonisjs/http-server: response.send(new Error()) serializes to {}
findings.note: Dropped after the panel (JSONP injection path; behaviour regressions).
findings.assessment: Dropped after panel. Do not use the original claimed behavior and proposed fix as a clean positive.

findings.title: adonisjs/http-server: toRoute mutates the caller's options
findings.note: Panel approved after text fixes.
findings.assessment: Reusing caller options loses query parameters because toRoute mutates them; panel approved after text fixes.

findings.title: adonisjs/http-server: type() writes Content-Type: false for unknown types
findings.note: Panel approved after text fixes.
findings.assessment: Unknown MIME type can produce Content-Type: false; media-type syntax and documented header behavior ground the mismatch.

findings.title: adonisjs/http-server: uuid matcher accepts non-hex letters
findings.note: Ready for review.
findings.assessment: Issue #50 / PR #53 provide historical intent; a-z accepts letters outside hexadecimal. Particularly useful issue-history case.

findings.title: aiohttp: readuntil() misses a separator split across chunks
findings.note: Ready for review; codeowners requested.
findings.assessment: Documented readuntil sequence contract, actual package red/green tests and asyncio parity. Original report explicitly code-only Phase 3; not evidence of external-document causation. STATUS says open; later Oct 3 handoff reports merged, not rechecked here.

findings.title: assertj: Percentage.toString() overflows for large whole values
findings.note: Not filed: assertj requires human-authored contributions.
findings.assessment: Large permitted percentage values saturate an int cast in toString; Maven red/green and related suites recorded. Contribution policy prevents filing, not research use.

findings.title: bionemo-recipes AMPLIFY: _pad_weights returns fp32 for bf16 input
findings.note: Ready for review; needs an NVIDIA member's /ok to test for CI.
findings.assessment: CPU PyTorch harness executes copied function; dtype loss reproduced. Sibling implementation supplies intended behavior. Full package/CUDA path was not executed; control reports often find this.

findings.title: bionemo-recipes collator: THD CP split drops remainder tokens
findings.note: Ready for review; needs /ok to test.
findings.assessment: Copied tensor-function harness reproduces dropped remainder tokens with explicit padding override; shipped default padding is safe. Sibling BSHD guard supports expectation. Full distributed execution not performed.

findings.title: calibre content server: 500 instead of 404 for malformed hex ids in OPDS feeds
findings.note: Merged by Kovid Goyal.
findings.assessment: Malformed hex raises through handler instead of yielding expected client error; sibling handlers support behavior. AST-extracted real handler harness, not end-to-end. Local records confirm merge. Original report says solely in-tree code.

findings.title: chi: AllowContentEncoding rejects "gzip, deflate"
findings.note: Already reported (#959, open PR #1182).
findings.assessment: Already reported upstream (#959 / PR #1182). May illustrate rediscovery, not a newly reported defect.

findings.title: chi: Mux.Find wildcard param after Mount
findings.note: Needs a maintainer's view rather than a patch.
findings.assessment: Needs maintainer interpretation of routing behavior; not yet a settled positive.

findings.note: Not filed: the fix caused a regression in review.
findings.assessment: Original mounted-router behavior reproduced in Go; proposed patch regressed during review. Keep original defect separate from failed fix. All controls missed it, but patch/adjudication work remains.

findings.title: chi: PathRewrite/PageRoute under Mount
findings.note: Needs a maintainer's view.

findings.title: chi: RegisterMethod race
findings.note: Leans working-as-designed.

findings.title: cobra: completion drops a flag-looking argument after --
findings.note: Full panel + focused re-review: all SHIP. Not yet presented under the protocol.
findings.assessment: Completion callback drops positional arguments after flag parsing stops; completion documentation gives expectation. Go tests/vet and re-review recorded.

findings.title: cobra: suggestion distance counts bytes, not runes
findings.note: CLA signed, ready for review. First submission under SUBMISSION-PROTOCOL.md.
findings.assessment: Suggestion distance counts bytes instead of runes; Unicode behavior and red/green/revert evidence. Filed PR.

findings.title: express: maxAge under 1 s sends Max-Age=0
findings.note: Dropped by Andrew after the panel (below cookie resolution; Max-Age=1 doubles the lifetime).
findings.assessment: Dropped by Andrew: requested precision is below cookie resolution and proposed round-up changes lifetime. Forty misses do not make it a valid positive.

findings.title: javalin: lowercase-path redirect drops the context path
findings.note: Full panel: SHIP.
findings.assessment: Redirect loses configured context path; concrete routing behavior, panel approved.

findings.title: javalin: precompressMaxSize = 0 disables precompression though docs say all sizes
findings.note: Dropped: the fix would cache every file in memory (the #2616 OOM). Docs and code disagree; no submission.
findings.assessment: Documentation/code disagreement is real, but proposed interpretation recreates memory exhaustion. Useful ambiguous-requirement example; exclude positive tally.

findings.title: nvmet: ANA group ID 128 clamped to 0 by array_index_nospec()
findings.note: Sent to linux-nvme 2026-09-10; awaiting review (see README).
findings.assessment: Boundary ANA group identifier misindexed; kernel/QEMU evidence and submitted patch. No matched standard-review result linked in this tally.

findings.title: nvmet: Property Get of CRTO computed from CSTS instead of CAP
findings.note: Sent to linux-nvme 2026-09-10; awaiting review (see README). MESSAGE-v3.txt is an unsent revision.
findings.assessment: CRTO timeout derived from CSTS instead of CAP; protocol-based expectation and kernel/QEMU evidence. User reports maintainer asked for concise explanation; that is not merge acceptance.

findings.note: Panel approved; needs the Gradle run.

findings.title: otel-java: UrlParser records server.address "[" for bracketed IPv6
findings.note: Panel approved; needs Andrew's Gradle spotless/check run before submitting.
findings.assessment: Bracketed IPv6 parsing violates host expectation across two copies. Real Java source red/green with standalone harness; Gradle run outstanding. Original discovery explicitly code-only Phase 3.

findings.title: pydantic: float multiple_of accepts inf/NaN
findings.note: Held by Andrew (same policy reason).
findings.assessment: Nonfinite values accepted by multiple_of; expected behavior grounded in numeric constraint semantics. Held for contribution-policy reasons.

findings.title: requests: codes.uri_too_long
findings.note: Ruled out: deliberate since PR #6680; similar report #7611 closed.
findings.assessment: Ruled out as intentional upstream behavior; exclude positive tally.
